title: Bounds on Extrapolated Treatment Effects in Regression Discontinuity Designs
abstract: arXiv:2412.04265v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: External validity is a central concern in regression discontinuity (RD) designs. To assess treatment effect heterogeneity and the representativeness of the conventional RD estimand, this paper studies the identifying content of monotonicity and smoothness restrictions for treatment effects away from the cutoff in both canonical and multi-cutoff RD designs. In the canonical design, monotonicity in the running variable alone has limited identifying power and generally yields only one-sided bounds. In multi-cutoff designs, by contrast, our proposed monotonicity restrictions along both the running-variable and cutoff-group dimensions yield a support-free characterization of the identified set. In both settings, smoothness restrictions may further tighten the identified set, underscoring the value of combining shape and smoothness restrictions. translated_title: 断点回归设计中外推处理效应的边界
translated_abstract: 外部效度是断点回归（RD）设计的核心问题。为了评估处理效应的异质性以及传统断点回归估计对象的代表性，本文研究了在标准断点回归设计和多断点设计两类框架下，针对断点之外处理效应的单调性约束与光滑性约束的识别内容。在标准设计中，仅依靠驱动变量上的单调性约束识别能力有限，通常只能得到单侧边界。相比之下，在多断点设计中，我们提出的沿驱动变量和断点组两个维度的单调性约束，能够实现对识别集的无支撑集刻画。在这两类设定中，光滑性约束均可进一步收紧识别集，这凸显了将形状约束与光滑性约束相结合的价值。这些尖锐识别集及其外近似均可用于偏差感知推断。
tldr: 本文在标准与多断点回归设计中，利用单调性和光滑性约束为断点之外的外推处理效应建立尖锐识别集，其中多断点设计下沿驱动变量与断点组两个维度的单调性约束可实现无支撑集的识别集刻画，并可结合偏差感知推断进行统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper derives sharp identified sets for treatment effects extrapolated away from the cutoff in canonical and multi-cutoff regression discontinuity designs, showing that monotonicity restrictions along both running-variable and cutoff-group dimensions yield a support-free characterization amenable to bias-aware inference.
